IN THE FAMILY COURT AT MANCHESTER
Application No: MA26F01877
APPLICANT: JOANNE PRICE
RESPONDENT: DARREN PRICE

STATEMENT OF JOANNE PRICE

I, Joanne Price, of Flat 4, 18 Mill Street, Salford M5 3AB, state as follows:

Background
I am 34 years old. I have been in a relationship with the Respondent Darren Price for eight years and we lived together at the above address until I fled to a refuge on 12 July 2026. We have a son, Callum, aged 5.

The abuse
On 2 July 2026 Darren punched me in the face during an argument about money and I fell against the door. I had a black eye for a week. He has regularly called me names and told me I am worthless. In June 2026 he took my bank card and has not returned it.
He has sent me text messages every day since I left. On 20 July 2026 he texted "I know where your mum lives".
I am frightened and I do not feel safe.

What I want
I am asking the court for a non-molestation order. I would like Callum to continue to live with me.

I believe the facts in this statement are true.
Joanne Price, 25 July 2026

IN THE FAMILY COURT AT MANCHESTER
Case No. MA26F01877
BETWEEN
JOANNE PRICE  (Applicant)
and
DARREN PRICE  (Respondent)

Order made by District Judge Hargreaves on 28 July 2026 at the Manchester Civil Justice Centre.
The Respondent attended in person. The Applicant was represented by Ms Sarah Dunne of counsel.
The court recorded that the respondent gave an undertaking to the court (see Schedule).

UPON hearing counsel for the applicant and the respondent in person
IT IS ORDERED:
1. The respondent must not use or threaten violence against the applicant.
2. The respondent must not intimidate, harass or pester the applicant.
3. The respondent must not telephone, text or contact the applicant by any means, except about the child through a third party.

6. No order for costs.

PENAL NOTICE
YOU MUST OBEY THIS ORDER. If you do not, you may be sent to prison for contempt of court.
